title: Laredo's New Barnes & Noble Launches Holiday Book Drive for Bethany House
excerpt: Laredo's new Barnes & Noble at Mall del Norte has launched a holiday book drive supporting Bethany House of Laredo, giving shoppers a way to put books in the hands of local families this holiday season.
content:
Laredo's new Barnes & Noble bookstore has launched a holiday book drive supporting Bethany House of Laredo, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The drive invites shoppers at the Mall del Norte store to donate books for Bethany House, a local nonprofit serving people in need in Webb County, according to the report.

The bookstore, Laredo's first Barnes & Noble, is located at 5300 San Dario Ave., Suite 240, in the former Forever 21 space on the mall's west side, between Main Event and TruFit Athletic Clubs, according to Barnes & Noble. The 19,000-square-foot store offers books, toys, games, magazines, gifts, vinyl and a café.

The store first opened its doors at the end of September for a soft opening that drew more than 700 visitors on its first day, and held its grand opening Oct. 23, according to the company. Local author Sofia Segovia hosted the ribbon-cutting ceremony and signed copies of her book, The Murmur of Bees.

“The reception of the first Barnes & Noble to open in Laredo has been joyful,” James Daunt, CEO of Barnes & Noble, said in the company's announcement.

Store manager Jessie Hernandez said the team has appreciated the welcome from the people of Laredo, adding that it speaks to the city's enthusiasm for books and literacy, according to the company.

Shoppers can follow the store at @bnlaredotx on social media for upcoming events and news, according to Barnes & Noble.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times; Barnes & Noble, Inc.
